# Gnom-Gnom

> > A keto and low-carb baking resource specializing in grain-free, sugar-free dessert recipes using almond flour and innovative techniques.

Gnom-Gnom provides detailed keto-friendly recipes with precise net carb counts, focusing on paleo-compatible baking methods and simple ingredient lists. The site emphasizes practical low-carb desserts that maintain texture and flavor while keeping carbohydrate content minimal.

## Key Topics

- keto recipes
- low-carb desserts
- almond flour baking
- sugar-free desserts
- choux pastry technique
- paleo baking
- net carb calculations
- grain-free recipes
- 5-ingredient recipes
- keto brownies
- keto donut holes

## Keto Dessert Recipes

- [(1/2g net carb!) Keto Donut Holes](https://www.gnom-gnom.com/web-stories/keto-donut-holes): Keto donut holes recipe using choux pastry and almond flour (0.5g net carb)
- [(1g net carb!) Keto Brownies](https://www.gnom-gnom.com/web-stories/keto-brownies): 5-ingredient fudgy keto brownies with almond flour (1g net carb each)
